features.quote: ALL Sawa Sawa Kizomba Festival activities will take place at the host Hotel, Hyatt Regency Bethesda
features.rationale: The festival activities take place at the hotel where dancers are invited to stay, so the event and accommodation share one venue.

features.quote: Steeply discounted Sawa Sawa sleeping rooms are currently available on sale.
features.rationale: The discounted sleeping rooms at the event hotel are a negotiated rate and are not stated as part of the pass.
Dance workshops are advertised as part of the festival.
A specialty bootcamp is offered as part of the festival.
A masterclass is offered as an optional purchase.
A daytime social is listed as part of the festival.
